resolvedStack: Electron + Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: GridWatch Substation OS
description: GridWatch Substation OS is a native Electron SCADA desktop console for monitoring electrical substation transformers, logging grid fault events, and scheduling field maintenance crews.

metadata.name: GridWatch Substation OS
metadata.description: Electron SCADA desktop console for substation nodes, fault logs, and maintenance dispatch.

files.description: Electron, Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, Zod, lucide-react, react-icons.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, NodeHealth, FaultSeverity, TaskStatus enums and User, SubstationNode, FaultEvent, DispatchOrder models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for SubstationNode, FaultEvent, DispatchOrder.
Tailwind CSS directives for SCADA operator console.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Desktop landing page for GridWatch Substation OS.
Desktop Command Center switching between SubstationGrid, FaultLogViewer, and MaintenanceDispatch.
Client renderer component displaying transformer load and health from /api/substations.
Client renderer component displaying grid fault events from /api/faults with severity filtering.
Client renderer component creating and tracking field maintenance orders.
Client hook fetching /api/substations on mount via useEffect.
GET and POST API route for SubstationNode records.
GET and POST API route for FaultEvent records.
